# Security policy

This repository is SKYCOT, made by Curble Pty Ltd (trading as SKYCOT), Melbourne, Australia. It is based on T3 Code; problems that are only in upstream T3 Code belong with T3 Tools Inc. (see https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code).

## Reporting a vulnerability in SKYCOT

Please report it privately, not in a public issue or pull request:

- use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** button on this repository's Security tab, or
- email markhallam@skycot.com with "SKYCOT security" in the subject.

Tell us what you found, how to reproduce it and which SKYCOT version you used. We will reply within 5 business days and keep you updated until it is fixed. Please give us a reasonable time to fix it before you disclose it publicly.

Especially in scope: anything that lets a child or another person get past the Family profile's grown-up checks, the parent code, phone pairing or the SKYCOT Relay; anything that lets someone install a build that is not a genuine signed SKYCOT update; and anything that exposes a family's data.

We will not take legal action against good-faith research that follows this policy, avoids other people's data and does not disrupt the service.
